text.content:
2062: a valley drowned, and a nation's refugees arrive.

When: 2062
Where: Laguna Bend; Pacifica
Who was involved: NC Dam Ltd; Haitian refugees; Agwe
What it changed: A toxic reservoir the city can't drink, and the Haitian community that built, and now holds, Pacifica

NC Dam Ltd flooded the valley behind Laguna Bend Dam, township and all, saying everyone had been moved out. The same year a hurricane leveled Haiti, and tens of thousands of refugees reached Night City. Most ended up pouring concrete for the Pacifica resort boom that began the following year. When the money left in 2069 they stayed, and since 2062 Agwe has organized them.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 13
